// PROBE — the same read, classified before it is counted.
import { excludeUnderReview } from "@/lib/gaps/provenance"
export async function newGapCount(db: any, userId: string) {
    const rows = await db.gapInstance.findMany({ where: { policy: { ownerUserId: userId }, status: "open" }, select: { definition: { select: { slug: true } } } })
    return excludeUnderReview(rows, (r: any) => r.definition.slug).length
}
